# FQHELatticeDensityMatrix

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnLattice` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnLattice/FQHELatticeDensityMatrix`

```text
FQHELatticeDensityMatrix, version 0.01

Usage: FQHELatticeDensityMatrix [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --states : filenames of state vectors to be processed (multiple arguments)
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (default value = 0)
    -x, --lx : length in x-direction of given lattice (default value = 0)
    -y, --ly : length in y-direction of given lattice (default value = 0)
    -q, --flux : number of flux quanta piercing the lattice (default value = 0)
    -Q, --cont-flux : multiples of flux quanta piercing the lattice (default value = 0)
    -s, --solenoid-flux : twist in periodic boundary conditions phi_x[,phi_y])
    -c, --hard-core : Use Hilbert-space of hard-core bosons
    -n, --no-hard-core : Do not use Hilbert-space of hard-core bosons (overriding detection from filename)
    --normalize-phase : change phase to make largest absolute value real and positive

lattice options:
    -L, --lattice-definition : File defining the geometry of the lattice
    -C, --cells-repeat : number of times unit cell is repeated in the x-, y-,..., dim- directions of the lattice (overriding default given in definition)
    --normalize-lattice : normalize unit cell area to #of sites, and field strength to one
    --external-parameters : values of external parameters for lattice definition

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

precalculation options:
    --fast-search : amount of memory that can be allocated for fast state search (in Mbytes) (default value = 9)

output options:
    -o, --output-file : redirect output to this file
    --plot-density : plot the density matrix eigenstates
    --save-vectors : write vectors, which yield maximum density matrix EV
    -v, --momentum-vectors : writes the basis of momentum eigenstates
    -r, --dynamic-range : range of density operator eigenvalues to be displayed (default value = 1.0000000000000001e-05)
    --show-translation : display the matrix defining the translation operator
    --show-basis : show elements of vector in basis and exit
    --currents : calculate expectation values of current operators and exit
    --display-threshold : only display values larger than threshold (default value = 0)

misc options:
    --nbr-density : number of density matrix eigenstates to be written out (default value = 1)
    --joint : evaluate joint density matrix for multiple vectors
    --equal : only use equal weight superpositions of two vectors
    -u, --superpositions : in case of two input vectors, number of values for phase in superpositions (default value = 12)
    --max-iter : maximum number of iterations for optimizing condensate fraction (default value = 250)
    --opt-tolerance : tolerance for optimizing condensate fraction (default value = 0.0001)
    --opt-random : start optimization from a randomized initial condition
    --opt-target : target for optimization on sum over first N eigenvalues (default value = 1)
    --expansion : obtain expansion image of state(s)
    --apply-gauge : Apply a gauge-transform before calculating expansion image - 1:doubled->Dali (default value = 0)
    --exp-offset : apply offset of momentum values for Fourier-Transform O_x,O_y)
    --no-momenta : do not calculate momentum of states
    -V, --verbose : give additional output
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
